code.$description: Space Mono. Only for code and program data (values, paths, line numbers). Never for interface text: labels, buttons, titles and messages use type/ui/fontFamily/primary.

body.$description: Weight for running interface text. Dark theme never goes above 300 (Light), so Dark = Light; Light theme = Regular.

emphasis.$description: Weight for titles, headings and emphasis. Dark theme never goes above 300, so Dark = Light; Light theme = Medium.
